title: Beyond the Threshold — solo-developed sci-fi action for iOS & Android | Trailer
author: Intelligent-Bat-2370
selftext:
I'm developing Beyond the Threshold solo in Unity under THEOMI. Here's the trailer! VAYA brings ranged firepower, while VAEL takes the fight up close with a katana. The game is still in development, coming first to iOS and Android.



The trailer combines game footage with AI-generated cinematic/concept sequences; those cinematic shots are not gameplay.



Following my earlier drone concept post, a bit more about the AI side: I've used Tripo quite a bit and tried Claude with Blender through an API workflow. The animations didn't turn out as I wanted, and some models had broken geometry. Preserving clean quad topology has been frustrating, so manually researching and cleaning things up has worked best for me so far. For others taking generated assets into Unity, where do you find manual cleanup saves the most time?



Which would you pick: ranged weapons or the katana?
